scope: adoq POC: Rust service+CLI that auto-retargets/rebases stacked ADO PRs and runs a batched merge queue, proven end-to-end against a local ADO REST digital twin and real bare git repos.

user_stories.text: As a developer I branch off a teammate's unmerged branch, open my PR, and when the parent merges my PR retargets and rebases itself.
As a maintainer I tag PRs for the queue and they merge in order only after a green build on the merged result.
As a maintainer I want green PRs batched so pipelines run as few times as possible, with a failing PR isolated automatically.
As an agent/operator I can inspect and drive the engine with `adoq ls` / `adoq do` without a UI.

non_goals: Real ADO org calls or credentials

acceptance_criteria.text: Workspace builds and unit tests pass headless.
Twin rejects calls without PAT (401), without api-version (400), unknown PR (404); paginates with $top/$skip; returns 429 + Retry-After past its budget.

Stack retarget+rebase: parent PR completed in twin → within one tick child PR targetRefName equals parent's target and its git branch contains no parent commits twice (linear, tip rebased onto new target); chain of 3 resolves across ticks.
Rebase conflict: child left untouched (no force-push), status adoq/stack=failed with message, event logged, other PRs continue.
With twin retargeting=off, bot detects the PATCH did not change targetRefName, posts failed status, does not rebase.
Serial queue: 3 queued PRs complete in FIFO order, each only after its queue build succeeded; target tip history shows that order.
Batching: 4 green PRs complete with ≤ 2 builds total; with 1 red PR in a batch of 4, culprit evicted with failed status, other 3 complete, builds ≤ 5.
Idempotence and restart: killing and restarting adoq mid-batch (SQLite state kept) never double-completes or double-pushes; second tick on unchanged state makes zero mutating API calls.

Reflex CLI: `adoq ls` prints JSON of stacks/queue/batches; `adoq do Enqueue '{"pr":N}'` drives the core; invalid action exits non-zero listing available actions; behaviour tests use only the CLI + twin fixtures.
Safety: PAT never appears in logs/telemetry/db; twin binds 127.0.0.1 only; a guard fails tests making non-loopback connections.
Telemetry: each scenario run appends valid JSON lines tick/retarget/rebase/batch/merge to $DATA_DIR/telemetry.jsonl with documented fields and no personal data.
Bench command's last stdout line is JSON with tick_p50_ms, rss_mb, builds_per_merged_pr; builds_per_merged_pr ≤ 0.3 on the 4-green-PR batch.
acceptance_criteria.verify: cargo run -q --release -p adoq -- bench | tail -1 | python3 -c 'import sys,json;d=json.loads(sys.stdin.read());assert d["builds_per_merged_pr"]<=0.3 and "tick_p50_ms" in d and "rss_mb" in d'

acceptance_criteria.text: Repo holds twins/ado/ README naming the Microsoft Learn pages followed and a LICENSE (MIT).
acceptance_criteria.verify: test -f twins/ado/README.md && grep -q 'learn.microsoft.com' twins/ado/README.md && test -f LICENSE

architecture_decisions.decision: Rust workspace: core engine (sync, no HTTP imports), adoq bin, twin-ado crate.
architecture_decisions.why: Fast small always-on binary; ports make behaviour tests run in ms (Reflex).

architecture_decisions.decision: Shell out to system git for rebase/merge-tree/push.
architecture_decisions.why: Rebase is not a REST call [X-005]; matches adopters' runner semantics.

architecture_decisions.decision: Poll + reconcile (level-triggered), state in SQLite, derive stack graph each tick.
architecture_decisions.why: Idempotent and restart-safe; no webhook infra needed; cached parent_id is never trusted.

architecture_decisions.decision: ADO twin under twins/ado/ with real bare repos, REST 7.1 shapes, fault flags.
architecture_decisions.why: No ADO org/credentials here; faithful to Learn pages [A-005].

architecture_decisions.decision: Queue builds run on temp branch queue/<n> via a Builds port; batch with bisection on failure.
architecture_decisions.why: Mirrors GitHub merge_group; whether ADO binds builds to such refs is unproven [A-006].

architecture_decisions.decision: Fresh JSON telemetry lines and a bench subcommand.

data_constraints: No work repos or corporate credentials on this box; fixture repos generated in tests
Telemetry has PR ids only, no names/emails
unresolved_assumptions: ADO retargeting feature is enabled in adopter orgs (default unverified)
Build validation/pipelines can run on non-PR queue refs, or be triggered via API
Bot identity can get contribute+force-push rights
wshm's queue does not already do batched ADO builds

risk_owners.risk: Real-ADO behaviour differs from the twin

rollback: Delete the repo and DATA_DIR; the bot only pushes queue/* and stacked-PR branches, and completion can be reverted by git revert.

assumption_tested.statement: The auto-retarget + rebase + batched queue loop can be built correctly as a poll-based headless service on ADO's documented REST surface plus plain git.
assumption_tested.how_tested: AC3-AC8 run the whole loop against a docs-faithful twin; refuted if rebased stacks come out non-linear, a batch double-completes after restart, or batching needs more builds than serial (AC12 > 0.3).

untested_risk.statement: ADO-heavy teams want a self-hosted bot for stacking/queues and will grant it force-push and PR-update rights.
untested_risk.why_not_tested: Demand evidence is weak [M] and cannot be gathered from this box; POC must not wait on interviews or an ADO org.
